in_marathi.name: Urja
in_marathi.long_meaning: Urja हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Urja is a Sanskrit and Hindi name meaning energy, power, and the vital force that keeps life going. It is derived from the Sanskrit word urjah, which means burning, ardent, and lively.
